faq.a1: Because the words are "skewered" together with a hyphen, looking like pieces of meat on a kebab.
faq.a2: Kebab uses hyphens (-), snake uses underscores (_). URLs love kebabs; databases love snakes.
faq.a3: Yes, Google and other search engines recommend using hyphens rather than underscores in URLs.
